subject.title: [BUG] exec tool: aborted run wedges subsequent exec calls in same session (regression from PR #94412)

question: Should #102006 be handled as a focused v2026.6.11 exec/tool wedge regression with live repro, or folded fully into the broader run-lifecycle reliability umbrella before repair?
rationale: The source shows partial recovery machinery on main, but the issue discussion reports concrete production wedges and the broader design issue may own the permanent state-machine/liveness shape.

options.title: Run focused repro and repair
options.body: Keep this issue open as a concrete regression, require packaged gateway proof, and land only the smallest fix that releases stale tool/model work consistently with #101863.

options.title: Fold into #101863
options.body: Treat this report as evidence for the broader lifecycle design and close it only after the umbrella has a merged track that explicitly covers this diagnostic shape.

options.title: Wait for more field logs
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause implementation until maintainers have additional redacted logs or a deterministic reproduction from affected deployments.

recommendation.title: Run focused repro and repair
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as a concrete regression, require packaged gateway proof, and land only the smallest fix that releases stale tool/model work consistently with #101863.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the merged abort-stop change and the most recent current-main liveness/recovery history for this area.
